summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (94/471)

data.turoyo: W iḏa d mapəč hən w bəṯr d omalle l ḥa: “Kalá aʕmux, háwliyo!”, — iḏa tuyo aʕme, gšəqli i ʕisaqṯo mu ġurub ḥreno, bəṯr hənnək gmakərxila.
data.translation: Und wenn er ein Paar Mann für leer erklärt hat und dann zu einem sagt: "Du hast ihn, gib ihn her!", und der betreffende hat ihn wirklich, so nehmen sie den Ring der anderen Partei ab, und nun lassen sie ihn herumgehen.

rationale: First new example of technicalIII2: singular subject and overt partitive player object, followed by identifying the actual holder.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.5/1222)

data.turoyo: Annaqqa i šeno čike gole wa, nuqro wa, fayəš admo, našəf biyya. Əmmi: "Afandəm, harke stene qṭəlle ḥa, mǧaraḥḥe hən mənayna las səyoyani." Ḥərle, ḥərle, omər: "U admano hawile 15 yawme! D qanyono ste yo, latyo dan noše." Nihaye, i masalaṯṯe mpawčolle, əmmi: "Šaraf di ʕaskariye lə ktəwrinale!"
data.translation: Then the ground was a little hollow, a depression; blood remained and dried in it. They say, 'Sir, here too they killed one; they wounded some of us on the fences.' He looked, looked, and says, 'This blood is fifteen days old! It is animal blood too; it is not human.' Finally they made the affair come to nothing. They say, 'We will not break the army's honor!'

rationale: First active II nullification example; retaining the evidence-dismissal context makes the figurative meaning recoverable.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.5/1270)

data.turoyo: Mpawčo i masale du ḥəmmam, du dappo yo. Hənne ʕal aṣ ṣəroye femayye ftiḥo we, Ǧan. Man d qəṭliwo, nošo lə umarwolən mede.
data.translation: The affair of the bathhouse was made to come to nothing; it is the depot affair. Their mouths were open for the Syrians, Jan. Whoever they might have killed, nobody would have said anything to them.

rationale: Patient counterpart of the nullification event in the same narrative. Retain reported Detransitive Preterit provisionally, with morphology queried.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 2.35/5529)

data.turoyo: Hani kulle ab beṯ-arkat dəṯṯe malye mak kṯowe das səryoye ne. Ašhar ʕamo wayye bi arʕo, bas mən yo u sabab mi naqqayo, hawxa xəd həwyo mzido d payčo, bə ḥḏo naqqa.
data.translation: All these, their libraries are full of Syriac books. They were the most renowned people on earth. But what was the reason, from that time, like an inflated thing that deflates, all at once...

rationale: Thin I Infectum cell has two examples; this explicit inflated-object simile provides a bridge to the community metaphor without adding a lexical sense.
